subject: Pricing Updates
body:
Image

Hi there,

 

We're changing some of our prices. The details are here ( https://fly.io/pricing-update?utm_campaign=Pricing+Updates&utm_content=Pricing+Updates&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ), and they'll go into effect on October 1. Here's the overview:

 

Sprites usage pricing is dropping. We've learned a lot about how people actually run Sprites since launch, and we're comfortable we can operate them more efficiently than we anticipated. So, we want to pass those savings on to our users: these changes represent a 45% cut to Sprites CPU prices and 50% cut to memory prices. 

 

Fly Machines memory prices are going up 20%. Server RAM prices have roughly tripled this year because of AI demand and we continue to see pressure in the memory supply chain, so we need to raise our prices to help offset these cost increases. (CPU prices are not going up.)  

 

If you have questions about any of this, hit reply and a human will respond.

 

Thanks,

The Fly.io Team
